name: MuJoCo
summary: Emo Todorov's MuJoCo solved soft contact dynamics accurately and fast enough for optimization-based control and reinforcement learning, becoming the substrate for essentially all continuous-control benchmarks. DeepMind acquired it and open-sourced it in 2021, later adding a GPU-accelerated version for massively parallel training.
innovation: A convex contact formulation that is both physically reasonable and fast enough to sit inside a learning loop.
Analytically tractable dynamics enabling gradient-based and optimal-control methods.
matters: Nearly every RL manipulation result of the last decade was developed on it.
limits: The contact model is an approximation, and deformables and fluids remain weak.
lineage: The root of the modern manipulation simulation stack.
